audience: freelancers and small businesses who bill clients with Invoice Ninja

useCases.title: Find overdue invoices and what each client owes
useCases.text: The AI lists invoices by payment status (paid, unpaid or overdue) and by client, and shows the balances.

useCases.title: Review payments, quotes and recurring invoices
useCases.text: The AI lists payments received with the invoices they paid, open quotes with their clients, and recurring invoice schedules with the next send date.

useCases.title: Create a draft invoice or quote for a client
useCases.text: The AI creates a draft invoice or quote with line items. Nothing is sent or emailed.

useCases.title: Send an invoice or convert a quote to an invoice
useCases.text: The AI emails an invoice to the client's contacts, marks it sent without email, or converts a quote into an invoice.

useCases.title: Track time, expenses and projects
useCases.text: The AI lists tasks with time logs, expenses, vendors and projects with budgeted hours, so you can see the work and costs.

useCases.title: Log time, an expense or a new project
useCases.text: The AI creates a task with time entries, an expense that can be re-invoiced, or a project with a rate, budget and due date.
